name: ZeroB Auto Softener 2.1
summary: The all-new ZeroB Softener automatically converts hard water into soft, safe water, enhancing bathing, washing, and laundry while preventing scale and scum.
intro: The ZeroB Auto Softener 2.1 automatically converts hard water into soft, safe water for bathing, washing and laundry while preventing scale and scum. It features a robust 6-stage fully automatic valve, a Built-In No Hard Water Bypass Valve (NHBV) during regeneration, and proprietary food-grade, tamper-proof purple resin for reliable, long-lasting performance.
features: Fully automatic programmable process valve with zero manual intervention
Softens water and prevents scale, scum and corrosion damage to bathroom fittings and appliances
Reduces detergent and soap consumption while protecting fabric colour and texture
Increases the lifespan of washing machines, water heaters and other appliances
Uses ZeroB's proprietary Purple Resin Media (RESIN Technology)

rows: FRP composite vessel tank & HDPE brine tank
